7. SAhiPLINC 7.1 Sampling and criteria for acceptance for carrom-strikers shall be as agreed to between the purchaser and the supplier. A recommended scheme for the same is given in Appendix A.
8. TEST 8.1 Each striker shall comply with the test given in 8.1.1.

8.1.1 When struck in a regular play, the carrom-stricker shall move smoothly in a flat position on the surface of a standard carrom-board ( see IS : 2719-19&P ) in a straight line.

A-3.1 Each striker in the sample shall be examined for material, dimensions, manufacture, workmanship and finish and tested in accordance with 8.1.1. A striker failing to meet any one or more of the requirements of this specification shall be considered as defective.
